title: Syrian Tagine Kebabs with Spring Vegetables
description: A fusion of Chinese and Middle Eastern flavors, these kebabs feature lamb cooked to perfection with a rich garlicky sauce and served with a colorful mix of spring vegetables.

ingredients.name: Spring vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, carrots, and snap peas

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together garlicky sauce, salt, and pepper.
Add lamb to the bowl and toss to coat with sauce.
Thread lamb and spring onions onto skewers.
Brush kebabs with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes, or until lamb is cooked to desired doneness.
While kebabs are cooking, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add spring vegetables to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
Serve kebabs with spring vegetables and enjoy!
